subject: Super Cucco Catching
text: The Super Cucco Catching minigame costs ten Rupees and requires finding all three Super Cuccos within thirty seconds.

evidence.quote: Speak with Talon and for ten Rupees you can challenge yourself to try to find all three Super Cuccos in thirty seconds.

subject: Super Cucco Catching
text: Finding all three Super Cuccos in the minigame rewards Link with Lon Lon Milk in an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: After you have located all three of the Super Cuccos, Talon will reward your with some LON LON MILK.
worth it but rather the EMPTY BOTTLE that you have after the milk is gone.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Dropping into the hole behind the small fence leads to a small treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Jump down behind you and you'll land beside a hole, drop down into the hole and open the small treasure chest to acquire a RED RUPEE.

subject: Cucco Catching
text: Returning all seven Cuccos to the pen for the woman in Kakariko Village rewards an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Now all you have to do is find those two which you threw over the fence for later and that takes care of all seven.
Speak to the girl and she will reward you nicely with another EMPTY BOTTLE.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley opens in Hyrule Market after completing Dodongo's Cavern and costs 30 Rupees per game.

evidence.quote: After you have completed the Dodongo's Cavern the Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market is open for business.  Each game costs 30 Rupees and you'll likely be playing a lot so be sure to bring a lot of money with you.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Randomized prizes available at the Bombchu Bowling Alley include Bombs, Purple Rupee, Bombchus, Piece of Heart, and the Biggest Bomb Bag.

evidence.quote: The prizes are Bombs, Purple Rupee, Bombchus, PIECE OF HEART [010] and BIGGEST BOMB BAG, the final two are obviously the ones you'll really be working toward.

subject: Diving Game
text: The Diving Game in Zora's Domain costs 20 Rupees and requires jumping down to collect all five Blue Rupees.

evidence.quote: You will have the option of playing the Diving Game for 20 Rupees.  The Diving Game is one of the easiest minigames ever, your goal is to jump down into the water and collect all five of the Blue Rupees.

subject: Diving Game
text: Successfully collecting all five Blue Rupees in the Diving Game rewards the Silver Scale, allowing Link to dive for six seconds.

evidence.quote: After successfully collecting all five Blue Rupees, head back up to where you started the game and speak to the Zora there once again.  The Zora will reward you with a SILVER SCALE which allows you to dive for six seconds rather than a mere three seconds, this means of course that you can go deeper as well.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching a ten-pound fish as Young Link in the Lake Hylia Fishing Pond awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Once you eventually catch this fish go back and talk to the guy at the counter, as a reward for the ten pound fish you get PIECE OF HEART [014].

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching a fish of at least fifteen pounds as Adult Link at the Fishing Pond rewards the Golden Scale, extending dive time to nine seconds.

evidence.quote: This fish should be at least fifteen pounds or more, which will net you the reward GOLDEN SCALE
and allow you to dive underwater for nine seconds as opposed to six.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Wearing the Skull Mask in the hidden hole past the right, left, right, left, left path in the Lost Woods prompts the Deku Scrub to grant a Deku Stick upgrade.

evidence.quote: Make a right at the beginning, then a left, then a right, then a left and then a left... Speak with the Deku Scrub on your right in order to get the next DEKU STICK UPGRADE.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Selling the Bunny Hood to the running man at Lon Lon Ranch and returning to the shop unlocks the Mask of Truth, allowing Link to hear rumors from Gossip Stones.

evidence.quote: There is also a special bonus, you are now free to borrow the MASK OF TRUTH whenever you want to.  The Mask of Truth allows you to listen to all those Gossip Stones placed conveniently around the world, before they really didn't do anything.
